item.title: The mayor of Scamtown
item.description:
"Join us in Scamtown, where the streets are paved with deceit and the mayor is always on the case. Tune in to 'The Mayor of Scamtown' podcast for lively discussions, humorous takes, and expert insights on the latest scams, frauds, and online threats. Subscribe now and stay informed!" (approx. 155-160 characters)
Alternatively, a shorter version: "Exposing scams and frauds, one story at a time. Tune in to 'The Mayor of Scamtown' podcast for expert insights and humorous takes." (approx. 125-130 characters)
